title: CareIQ patient delivery and staff notifications — screen inventory
status: proposed designs; no application integration or provider activation

coverage_definitions.drawn: Reviewable local page/dialog/state exists; production behavior is not implied.
coverage_definitions.partial: Some aspects are drawn; listed production variants or commands remain specification requirements.
coverage_definitions.specification_only: Requirement and integration notes only; a related entry/preview may exist.

platform_coverage.responsive_web: Prototype drawings; root validation record is authoritative for browser checks.
platform_coverage.patient_email_sms: Synthetic email/SMS and phone-width web journey previews.
platform_coverage.native_ios_android: Adaptation requirements only; no installed-device acceptance or native screens claimed.

global_contracts: Status text and icons never rely only on color.
Request/document state, delivery intent/attempt evidence, staff read state and current work state remain separate.
Current server authorization governs record content, badges, counts and deep links.
No real recipients, provider calls, persistent clinical drafts or actual authentication in the prototype.
Patient launch access preserves canonical adult-self boundary; proxy/minor extension is out of scope.

surfaces.name: Patient communication preferences

canonical_integration_points.anchor: existing independently verified account binding
authenticated released exact-version copies
request-only public workflow, terminal and completion states

production_requirements_not_verified_by_: Proposed GET/PATCH /api/v1/patient-paperwork/communication-preferences resolve current adult-self account/grant contexts with a server-issued preferenceContextToken, current revision and idempotency. No patientId/address/identity binding edits; origin/CSRF controls and current portal authority required.
Preference withdrawal appends current purpose/channel event; cannot be confused with signing/treatment consent.
Offer supported alternate communication and truthful effective timing.

surfaces.name: Provider callback trust boundary and receipt review
production_requirements_not_verified_by_: No tenant context derived from route handle or payload practice/patient IDs.
Verify provider-specific raw bytes, canonical request context and replay/timestamp before durable platform receipt.
Resolve trusted clinical scope only from existing connection/account/message mapping; bounded encrypted unmatched quarantine and narrow operational principal.
No generic webhook trust header or credentials invented in browser.

api_scope_note: proposed-api.yaml contains only routes explicitly named in backend-design.md section 8, including lookup-only reconciliation, atomic queued-intent cancellation and patient account communication preferences. Provider admin setup, contact verification, portal binding and source-work commands reuse existing or separately reviewed contracts; none is invented by this outline.
